subject: a small pale-pink anemone garden

composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Photograph a small garden of pale-pink anemones confined to the bottom third. Their short rounded tentacles lean together under a gentle current, with a few foreground tips in crisp focus. Use diffuse green-blue water light and restrained color, avoiding glowing neon. The background gradually becomes smooth aqua haze, keeping the scene tender, organized and visually restful. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
